model.name: R19.21.A: Members and Files nodes are rb-object-item folder nodes containing child items, not bespoke section headers.
model.description: The 'Members' and 'Files' nodes in the in-room tree MUST be THEMSELVES rb-object-item instances of folder/collection type — NOT bespoke section headers with custom styling. They contain member items / file items as expandable/collapsible children (folder semantics, same item model as /trace). This fixes the black-on-black contrast issue (bespoke headers become real items with proper theming) and enforces the R19.21 component-identity constraint at the structural level: every node in the room tree is an rb-object-item, including the two root folders.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "members and folders black on black and basically they shall be themselves items and be treated like folders containing the other items."
model.refinementOfNote: Refines R19.21 (in-room tree uses rb-tree + rb-tree-item from /trace). R19.21 established component-identity; R19.21.A adds the structural constraint that 'Members' and 'Files' themselves are rb-object-item folder nodes (not custom headers), containing child items with expand/collapse folder semantics. Also fixes the black-on-black rendering because real rb-object-items inherit proper contrast theming.
